notes: DiscoFlate v3.48.2 — 🎭 STAGES TAB: design overlay scenes OBS-style. Create a Stage, link a Gameplay Preset, pick a resolution, then drag overlays onto the canvas (drag the ◢ corner to resize). Each overlay is always-on (part of the scene) or callable (a one-tap button on the Chat tab). Two system overlays included: a live Capacity Gauge and a Pump Timer. The 🗂 Media browser is the universal library — uploads land in data/images, so ⬇ Export Stage bundles the design plus its media into one .dfstage.zip that ⬆ Import Stage unpacks anywhere. Global overlays are callable from every stage. On a video channel, pick a Stage in the 🎥 section: its callable overlays become buttons, ▶ Start virtual cam puts the always-on items and live gauges on the feed, and 🎭 Stage opens the phone view with that design. ISOLATE: a checkbox on the Chat tab that sends every broadcast ONLY to the active channel, even when other channels are live (direct command replies still land where they were typed).
